  • Strong engineering fundamentals and adaptability, with the ability to quickly navigate unfamiliar codebases, languages, and technical environments to deliver production-ready solutions
  • Hands-on experience with design systems and design-to-code workflows, including component libraries, tokens, documentation, and the tooling that connects design artifacts to production code
  • Proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python, including demonstrated fluency with agentic coding tools (e.g., MCP, agent orchestration). You have hands-on experience integrating APIs and SDKs, troubleshooting toolchains and CI environments, and navigating enterprise requirements such as SSO, security reviews, access controls, data residency, and compliance frameworks
  • Comfort owning ambiguous technical problems end to end, identifying patterns across customer engagements, and turning field learning into reusable product improvements

While it's not required, it's an added plus if you also have:

Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

The Figma Research team is hiring a seasoned researcher to support Figma’s Agentic Experiences, and actively shape and execute research to drive scale, tap new opportunities, and ensure Figma continues pushing innovation in design and production tooling. Because Figma is used by so many of the leading software companies around the world, you will be uniquely positioned to advance the state of how product development works across the entire industry.

This work sits at the center of one of the most consequential shifts in our industry: how designers and developers build software alongside AI. That means researching experiences where the output is nondeterministic and “did it work?” is a judgment call rather than a pass/fail, digging into questions about trust, verification, control, and how expectations change as what is possible changes. We are looking for someone energized by that ambiguity rather than waiting for it to resolve.

The ideal candidate brings a deep passion for research and strategy, pushing the envelope with AI led experiences, and laddering key user needs to critical product decisions and broader business impact. Partnering with Product, Design, and Engineering, you will tackle our highest impact problems, influencing company strategy for both the short- and long-term. You will own your problem space end to end and you will be expected to bring a point of view on product decisions. 

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Help Figma grow and innovate by delivering strategic research and recommendations and materially influencing the vision and strategy for Figma’s Agentic Experiences
  • Partner closely with product leaders to identify opportunities, generate strategy, and define success
  • Break down complex business challenges into clear research plans; own the end to end research process and leverage strong storytelling skills to deliver meaningful impact to Figma’s businesses
  • Leverage your product mindset and storytelling chops to influence product roadmap
  • Move fluidly between multi-quarter strategic direction and specific, in-the-weeds recommendations a designer or PM can act on next week
  • Advocate for the role of Research as a strategic partner in the business process, and raise the craft bar around you through mentorship and the standards you set

We’d love to hear from you if you have:

  • 7+ years of experience in UX research or user insights at a high growth B2B SaaS company 
  • Direct experience conducting research on AI-powered products and features, including evaluating experiences where there is no single correct output and a point of view on how users build (or lose) trust in them over time
  • A track record of owning significant research programs independently, including framing the question, choosing the approach, and driving the follow-through on product recommendations  
  • Expertise in utilizing a variety of research methodologies, including both qualitative and quantitative techniques, to address product challenges spanning from opportunity identification, concept testing, to feature iterations.
  • Comfort with product telemetry and analytics: able to form a hypothesis from behavioral data and partner with data science as a peer rather than outsourcing the numbers
  • Demonstrated success in identifying assumptions that underpin key challenges, prioritizing the most critical assumptions, and creating right sized research approaches to test those critical assumptions. 
  • A proven track record of gaining buy in from executive stakeholders and cross disciplinary partners, transcending mere research mechanics and findings to articulate a larger user story, and the “so what” to inspire action
  • Ability to balance speed and rigor, pivot directions, seek out new perspectives, receive feedback, and seek solutions in creative ways.
  • Ability to balance user research, strategy, business insights, team input, and intuition in decision-making processes

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience researching design tooling, developer tools, creative software, or other products where the users are themselves building things
  • 2+ years in product design, user centric product management, product development, and/or front end engineering
  • Experience partnering with model or evaluation teams, and a view on how qualitative signal and offline evals inform one another
  • A familiarity and depth of experience using Figma’s products

If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You'll rotate across product areas, ramp up quickly, and build relationships as you go, energized by unfamiliar products and ambiguous problems and ready to take initiative rather than wait for a fully scoped brief. You bring strong opinions about what makes a great experience, grounded in the needs of the people using it, spot connections across product areas, and combine deep qualitative and quantitative research expertise with a flexible, resourceful approach to moving quickly without sacrificing rigor. Beyond individual studies, you bring a clear point of view on what to build or change, tailor your communication to your audience, and are willing to challenge assumptions and say the hard thing with care—asking for help when you need it and offering it when others do.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Scope and run focused research in quick sprints, using sound methods to answer the questions most likely to change a product decision
  • Turn findings into specific recommendations a designer or PM can act on, working through tradeoffs and helping the team put them into practice
  • Present product recommendations to cross-functional teams and senior leadership, telling the story behind the data, not just reporting insights
  • Rotate across product areas and teams as needed, building credibility and relationships quickly without being embedded long-term
  • Contribute beyond research studies by using our products, joining design reviews, and helping teams recognize when they have enough information to act
  • Bring clarity to ambiguous problems, challenge assumptions, and adjust the scope or approach as you learn
  • Experiment with tools, templates, and workflows to make research faster and sharper

  • 7+ years of experience in research at high-growth product organizations, UX/design agencies, or strategic consultancies focused on digital experiences
  • Proficiency in mixed methods research, including qualitative approaches such as interviews and quantitative approaches such as surveys and data analysis
  • Strong product judgment, with examples of specific recommendations you made and how they shaped the product, backed by strong communication and storytelling skills with a track record of securing executive buy-in
  • Experience ramping up quickly on new projects and delivering clear recommendations in one- to two-week research sprints, turning ambiguous problems into clear questions and a practical path forward
  • A scrappy, flexible approach, adapting to changing priorities and tight timelines while maintaining sound research methods, including active use of AI tools to improve speed, quality, or scale

  • Proficiency in designing and prototyping, ideally within the Figma suite of tools

You will partner closely with teams across the company and focus on systemic security improvements and risk reduction. You will also participate in operational security responsibilities like security reviews, consulting, vulnerability triage, and security incident response.

Examples of what you may work on across teams:

AI Security

  • Perform technical security assessments, code audits, and design reviews for new AI infrastructure, platforms, and products.
  • Design and develop technical solutions to secure AI models, tooling, debugging workflows, and data pipelines.
  • Advocate for secure practices across Figma’s AI infrastructure, platforms, and data systems.
  • Build the next generation of internal AI-powered access insights and security tooling.
  • Help run penetration testing and offensive security exercises against Figma’s AI infrastructure, platforms, and products.

Platform Security

  • Perform technical security assessments, code audits, and design reviews for changes to Figma’s cloud and corporate infrastructure.
  • Design and develop solutions to prevent or mitigate cloud and corporate security risks.
  • Advocate for secure practices within Figma’s cloud and corporate infrastructure.
  • Build platforms and tooling to detect and respond to infrastructure and corporate security threats.

This is a rare combination. Figma is a beloved brand with a creative community that already wants to hear from us, and a video function that is still yours to build.

This is a full time role based in San Francisco or New York hub, or remotely in the United States.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Set the strategy: Define the role video plays across brand, social, editorial, product launch, community, and event moments. Own the format architecture and the prioritization framework that decides what we make and what we pass on
  • Build franchises: Create and run a portfolio of recurring video programs that compound audience over time, alongside the campaign and launch work. Own the development pipeline for new formats and the call to renew, evolve, or retire a series
  • Build the engine: Decide what we produce in-house, what goes to agencies and directors, and what we source from creators, with the economics behind each. Own the video budget and vendor relationships, and build the standards we are missing today around briefing, review, rights, and asset reuse
  • Lead the craft: Set and hold the quality bar for video made anywhere under the Figma brand. Write and approve briefs, run creative reviews, and enable cross-functional teams producing their own video with guardrails and coaching rather than gatekeeping
  • Measure what matters: Partner with our Brand Marketing Technologist to define what good looks like for each format and franchise, instrument it, and report it in a way that changes what we make next
  • Grow the team: Lead, hire, and develop the video team and the external bench, and make the case for the resourcing the strategy requires

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 10+ years across video, brand storytelling, editorial, content strategy, or production leadership, including several years leading a video function or team
  • A track record creating and running recurring video franchises that outlasted a single season and grew an audience
  • Experience owning a production model end to end: the in-house versus agency versus creator call, a real budget, and the partner relationships behind it
  • People leadership. You have hired, developed, and given hard feedback to producers, editors, or an external bench
  • Fluency across the format spectrum, from social-first short-form to long-form storytelling, launch films, and customer narratives, with clear opinions on what each format is good for
  • The ability to set a creative bar for work made by people who do not report to you, and to hold it without becoming the bottleneck
  • Comfort as the video voice in rooms with senior stakeholders, including the judgment to disagree productively and the measurement literacy to defend your decisions

  • Experience with live event and conference content at scale

title: AI GTM Specialist
text:

title: Analytical Engineer
text:
The Data Science & Analytics team at Asana is how the company turns data into decisions — defining the questions that matter, surfacing the answers, and making sure insight is at the center of every critical product and business call. As a Senior Analytical Engineer, you sit at the intersection of Data Engineering, Analytics, and Data Science, and you own the data foundations for a business domain end to end. Your mandate is to turn raw data into reliable, business-ready datasets that PMs, analysts, data scientists, and leaders actually trust and use — and to define the business logic and metric standards that make AI-powered self-serve trustworthy. You consume governed Silver tables and produce the Gold layer and semantic layer beneath Asana's most important metrics, dashboards, and Genie spaces. 

This role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday, with the option to work from home on Wednesdays and, depending on the work and the teams you partner with, on Fridays. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office expectations.

What you'll achieve:

  • Own the Gold layer for a given business domain (e.g. PLG funnel, marketing attribution, revenue, NPI/AWM): Design and continuously improve the curated, dimensional data models that downstream dashboards, Genie spaces, and ELT reporting depend on.
  • Implement the canonical business logic behind your domain's core KPIs: Translate KPIs into governed, versioned metric marts that resolve "this number doesn't match" disputes for good.
  • Build and curate the semantic layer and Genie spaces that power self-serve in your domain: Author the metadata, documentation, and prompt/metric definitions that let stakeholders query governed data in plain language through Claude and Databricks Genie.
  • Own the metric dictionary for your domain: a single source of truth for what each metric means, who owns it, and where to find it. Partner with peers across DS&A to keep KPI definitions consistent where domains overlap.
  • Author data contracts and SLAs at the Silver→Gold boundary, partnering with Horizontal Data Engineering on the inputs you depend on, and owning data quality, freshness, and oncall for Gold/metric-mart failures in your domain.
  • Build and maintain certified, board-ready dashboards on governed Gold data, partnering with Data Science to translate insight requirements into trusted, reusable products rather than one-off builds.
  • Partner directly with Product & Business, Data Science, and Engineering to turn ambiguous, underspecified questions into scalable datasets — anticipating downstream reporting impacts before they become incidents, and raising the data-model quality bar across the domains you touch.

 

About you:

 

  • 4+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a closely related analytics role, with a track record of independently owning the data models a team relies on for decisions.
  • Advanced SQL and strong data modeling fundamentals: dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, and semantic layer design.
  • Hands-on experience with a transformation framework (dbt or equivalent), orchestration tooling (e.g. Airflow), version control (Git), and modern warehouse/lakehouse platforms (Databricks experience preferred).
  • Practical experience with data quality testing and observability, schema management and data contracts, and query/model performance and cost tuning.
  • Demonstrated domain fluency in at least one business area (e.g. PLG funnels, SLG pipeline, marketing attribution, Product telemetry, revenue/ARR) and the judgment to translate "I don't trust this number" into a specific, durable model fix.
  • Strong cross-functional partnership skills: requirement gathering, prioritization, documentation and enablement, driving alignment on metric definitions, and explaining technical tradeoffs to non-technical partners.
  • Curiosity about AI-native analytics — NL2SQL, metadata/semantic layers for self-serve, and using tools like Claude and Genie to multiply your reach rather than replace rigor. Exposure to Unity Catalog, Looker/LookML, or reverse-ETL/activation (Salesforce, Marketo, Gainsight) is a plus.

We know that the best ideas and solutions come from multi-dimensional teams. That's because these teams reflect a variety of backgrounds and professional experiences. If you are excited about this role and feel your experience can make an impact, please don't be shy - apply today.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we’ll offer

  • Generous, transparent and fair compensation system (base salary and RSUs)
  • Contract of Employment (and the option of 50% tax deductible costs for author’s rights usage in respect of applicable roles ) 
  • Health insurance with dental and travel coverage (Lux Med) 
  • Breakfast and lunch catering on the days that you work from the office
  • Vacation allowance
  • Career growth budget 
  • Home office setup budget 
  • Gym/Fitness card
  • Fertility healthcare and family-forming support with Carrot
  • Mental Health Support in Modern Health
  • Group life insurance
  • MacBooks with all necessary accessories

title: API Support Engineer
text:
As a Developer Support Engineer, you’ll be a trusted technical partner for developers and customers integrating with the Asana platform. You’ll focus on API-related troubleshooting, developer workflows, and integration challenges - helping customers build reliably and confidently on top of our APIs. This is a hands-on role requiring basic programming skills, strong analytical skills, API debugging expertise, centered on delivering high-quality, developer-first support, combining technical depth with clear, empathetic communication.

In this role, you’ll work closely with customers to understand their use cases, diagnose complex technical issues, and advocate for improvements to our APIs and platform capabilities. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and Developer Relations to drive scalable solutions, share developer insights, and improve the overall integration experience. You’ll thrive here if you’re technically curious, detail-oriented, and passionate about helping developers succeed through thoughtful, durable solutions—not just quick fixes.

This role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. Along with most Asanas, you’ll work from this office in person on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays and Fridays. If you're interviewing for this role, your Talent Acquisition Partner will share more about the in-office requirements.

You will:

  • Provide technical support to customers, including debugging, troubleshooting and resolving API-related issues. Given the complexity and breadth of Asana's use across many industries, this is not a typical "question and answer" support role.
  • Triage and escalate API-related bugs and critical issues to R&D teams.
  • Support developers through email, our community forum, and live chat, ensuring they can successfully build on our platform.
  • Monitor internal Slack channels for urgent API support requests.
  • Collaborate with R&D teams to understand our API and influence improvements based on customer feedback.
  • Assist with API releases by communicating changelog updates and deprecation notices.
  • Review and approve third-party app integrations based on security and compliance guidelines.
  • Update developer documentation to clarify API usage and best practices.
  • Act as a liaison between API teams and Customer Support to ensure smooth communication about upcoming releases and changes.
  • Provide customer communication support during incidents involving API, webhooks, or event streams.

About you:

  • 3+ years of experience in technical support, developer support, application development or a related role.
  • Experience developing or integrating applications using APIs (including personal projects).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong understanding of REST API fundamentals (HTTP methods, JSON, pagination, query parameters, request bodies/responses).
  • Ability to write and debug scripts in JavaScript or Python to interact with APIs.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and debugging skills, with the ability to interpret error messages and resolve API-related issues.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, product, and support teams.
  • Comfortable with and has experience working in fast-paced, agile, and ambiguous environments while working in a consultative manner with customers

Nice to have:

  • Understanding of OAuth concepts and authentication protocols.
  • Basic Git proficiency.
  • Familiarity with webhooks and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience with command-line tools and basic Linux/Unix navigation.
  • Prior experience in developer relations, technical writing, or API advocacy.
  • Experience working with the Asana API or similar productivity tool APIs.
  • Experience with PowerBI and/or Tableau custom connectors
  • Public speaking, blogging, or content creation about technical topics.

What we offer

  • Generous, transparent and fair compensation system (base salary and generous Restricted Stock Unit for Asana Inc.) 
  • Contract of Employment (with 50% tax deductible costs for author’s rights usage for Engineers) 
  • Health insurance with dental and travel coverage (Lux Med) 
  • Lunch catering on the days that you work from the office
  • Career growth budget 
  • Home office setup budget 
  • Gym/Fitness reimbursement
  • Fertility healthcare and family-forming support with Carrot
  • Mental health support in Modern Health
  • Group life insurance
  • MacBooks with all necessary accessories


For this role, the estimated base salary range is between 13 500 - 14 650  PLN gross monthly on the contract of employment (UoP). The actual base salary will vary based on various factors and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base compensation range for this role may be modified.

Our total compensation consists of base salary and equity (RSUs).

title: Backend Software Engineer

title: Benefits Manager, NAMER
text:

You will own key offerings, including health & welfare benefits, wellness, and retirement, ensuring every Asana has access to comprehensive, competitive support. The People Team at Asana works to enable all Asanas to achieve our goals as a company in a way that is consistent with our values. We focus on recruiting, developing, and retaining exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds, ensuring that everyone can thrive, grow, and make a meaningful impact in support of Asana's broader mission: to help humanity thrive by enabling all teams to collaborate seamlessly and effectively.

This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

  • Partner with the Head of Global Benefits to own the strategy, design, and execution of high-impact benefits programs across the U.S. and Canada.

  • Shape Benefits Strategy: Design and continuously improve the overall experience, communications, and delivery of benefits programs, maximizing employee well-being and reducing friction for all Asanas.

  • Manage Vendor and Broker Relationships: Own relationships with brokers, carriers, and third-party administrators across medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and retirement programs, leading renewals and ongoing performance management.

  • Serve as the Benefits Systems Expert: Establish yourself as the administrator for our benefits administration platform, advising People Ops and cross-functional teams on strategy for enrollment, data integrity, governance, reporting, and process optimization.

  • Build Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with stakeholders in People Operations, Payroll, Finance, Legal, and Talent Acquisition to integrate benefits into the end-to-end employee lifecycle and lead cross-functional change initiatives.

  • Ensure Compliance: Maintain deep working knowledge of relevant regulations (including ERISA, ACA, HIPAA, FMLA, and state-specific leave laws), ensuring programs and plan documents remain compliant.

  • Maximize Program Outcomes: Design measurable frameworks for benefits utilization, employee satisfaction, and cost management using data to inform future strategy and investment.

  • Apply an AI-first approach to streamline benefits administration and case management, creating personalized employee communications.

  • 6+ years of experience in benefits program management, with a track record of owning and scaling health & welfare, and retirement programs.

  • Strong working knowledge of NAMER benefits compliance requirements (ERISA, ACA, HIPAA, FMLA, and state paid leave laws); familiarity with Canadian benefits programs is a plus.

  • Familiarity with total rewards philosophy and inclusive, equity-informed benefits design.

  • Clear, compelling communicator, both verbally and in writing, capable of synthesizing complex plan information and guiding employees with empathy.

  • Approach problem-solving with a strong sense of urgency, meticulous attention to detail, and exceptional time management skills.

title: Commercial Counsel
text:
The Legal team at Asana works collaboratively across functions to achieve our ambitious mission of fostering effortless teamwork for everyone. We are a tightly-knit and cooperative group committed to supporting teams throughout the organization, ensuring they have the necessary resources for success while protecting Asana's core values and interests. Within our team, we exchange ideas, collectively solve problems, and collaborate with other groups to navigate through challenging issues. We’re looking for a Commercial Counsel to join our Commercial Legal team, working closely with cross-functional stakeholders with a primary focus on supporting our global sales organization. In this role, you will report directly to the Global Head of Commercial Legal.

This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner.   • Draft, negotiate, and advise on outbound commercial agreements and strategic partnership agreements with enterprise customers, including SaaS agreements and related agreements such as DPAs, BAAs, Product-Specific Terms, and AI terms.

  • Act as a trusted legal advisor to sales teams, delivering timely and practical guidance, and driving transaction structures that align with Asana’s policies and business objectives.

  • Train sales teams on common commercial issues and best practices in support of closing transactions efficiently.

  • Apply innovative thinking to the development and scaling of commercial legal team best practices and resources—including internal knowledge-sharing materials, scalable frameworks, legal playbooks, and standards that drive deal velocity and quality.

  • Stay current on emerging global laws, regulatory shifts, and judicial decisions relevant to our business (including competition and data protection laws), conducting thorough research to proactively adapt internal legal guidelines.

  • Support and manage a variety of high-impact ad hoc legal projects as they arise.

  • J.D. degree from an accredited institution and active membership in good standing with a U.S. state bar association.

title: Copywriter
text:
The Asana Marketing team fuels business growth across revenue marketing, product marketing, brand, content, advertising, and lifecycle programs. We build campaigns, content, and experiences that drive impact at scale.

As our Senior Copywriter, you will be the definitive creative voice across Asana's Brand Creative team—shaping how the brand speaks across every channel, medium, and moment that matters.

This is a leaderful role as much as a writing role: you will define and steward our brand voice, set the standard for copy quality across the creative team, and bring language to life across campaigns, performance ads, sizzle reels, demo video scripts, and more. You will work at the intersection of strategy and craft—partnering closely with art directors, designers, producers, and cross-functional stakeholders—to translate briefs into work that is sharp, original, and unmistakably Asana. You will also be a teacher and force multiplier: codifying our voice in frameworks and guidelines others can apply, mentoring colleagues, and raising the bar for written communication across the Marketing organization.

You bring deep conviction and active curiosity to your work, including a genuine interest in how AI can augment the craft of writing. You know how to use these tools intelligently without sacrificing creative ownership, and you build workflows that help the team move faster without compromising quality or your own originality.

This role is based in our Vancouver, BC office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. Along with most Asanas, you’ll work from this office in person on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays and Fridays. If you're interviewing for this role, your Talent Acquisition Partner will share more about the in-office requirements. 

What you'll achieve

  • Define, steward, and evolve Asana's brand voice: building the guidelines, frameworks, and reference materials that make great writing scalable across Marketing surfaces
  • Serve as the hands-on writer and copy authority on campaigns, crafting language across formats, including: ads, landing pages, release communications, sizzle reels, demo video scripts, social content, and event materials
  • Lead copy on the highest-complexity, highest-visibility initiatives from brief through final delivery—managing feedback cycles, cross-functional input, and timelines along the way
  • Partner closely with art directors, designers, and producers to shape integrated creative, ensuring copy and design tell a coherent, compelling story together
  • Mentor and coach colleagues and cross-functional partners on what does and doesn't ring true to Asana's voice; develop resources and tools that make strong writing more accessible to the wider team
  • Drive alignment with senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners, presenting creative rationale confidently and leading feedback conversations with clarity and conviction
  • Connect language and copy decisions to business outcomes, advocating for creative choices in terms of audience, objective, and measurable impact
  • Identify and implement AI-powered writing workflows that increase speed, efficiency, and creative range, while maintaining authorial voice and original thinking
  • Manage vendors and contract copywriters as needed, ensuring quality and brand consistency
  • Give and receive direct, constructive feedback through critique, and contribute to a creative culture where high standards and generosity coexist
  • Manage multiple initiatives simultaneously with strong organizational judgment, moving projects reliably from brief to execution

About you

  • 8+ years of professional copywriting experience, ideally in-house at a technology company or at an agency working on tech brands
  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.
  • A portfolio that demonstrates range across campaign copy, video scripts, digital advertising, and branded content—with a clear and distinctive point of view of B2B and B2C creative
  • Recognized expertise in brand voice: you've built and documented voice frameworks, and you can teach others to apply them with consistency and confidence
  • Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional creative projects from brief to delivery with minimal oversight
  • Experience working alongside designers and cross-functional stakeholders in a deeply integrated creative process
  • Strong strategic instincts: you connect language choices to business objectives and can make the case for your creative decisions to senior and executive stakeholders
  • A fluent, confident communicator—verbally and in writing—who can drive alignment, present work persuasively, and model clear thinking for others
  • Demonstrated curiosity about AI tools and experience incorporating them into writing workflows to improve speed, efficiency, or creative range—without losing authorial ownership
  • High EQ and a growth mindset; you welcome feedback, generously share knowledge, and approach collaboration with a "yes, and" attitude
  • All submissions must include a link to a portfolio or writing samples

title: Corporate Account Executive, DACH
text:
We are entering a new era of work — one where AI agents collaborate alongside people to plan, act, and deliver outcomes at a scale and speed that wasn't possible before. At Asana, we call this Agentic Work Management: the orchestration of humans and AI agents toward shared goals, with full clarity on who is responsible for what, every step of the way. As a Corporate Account Executive, you will be at the forefront of this shift. You won't just be selling software — you'll be helping DACH organisations understand and solve their most pressing work management challenges, and guiding them toward a future where their teams and AI agents move together with purpose and trust.

This role is based in our Munich office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday.   • Lead with Discovery: Open every engagement with genuine curiosity to uncover hidden friction, misaligned priorities, and coordination failures that cost customers time, money, and trust.

  • Map Stakeholder Motivations: Map stakeholder motivations from frontline teams to the C-suite, identifying where the greatest leverage lies for transformative change.
  • Drive Customer Outcomes: Manage a portfolio of corporate customers with a relentless focus on measurable business impact and outcomes that your champions can proudly report upward.
  • Expand Account Revenue: Hunt and develop new business within your book while deepening relationships across existing accounts, expanding usage into new teams and departments.
  • Engage Executive Leadership: Engage executive and IT stakeholders to align on organisation-wide deployment of Asana, making it the connective tissue between human decision-making and AI-driven execution.
  • Territory Strategy Execution: Design and execute a clear quarterly territory strategy aimed at revenue growth and long-term customer success.
  • Build Trust in Collaboration: Help customers envision and confidently adopt a new way of working where AI agents are trusted teammates with clearly defined roles.
  • Articulate Platform Value: Articulate how Asana's Agentic Work Management platform provides the structure, accountability, and transparency needed to make human-AI collaboration reliable and scalable.
  • Champion Ownership Shifts: Champion the shift from activity-based work to outcome-based work, showing how clarity of ownership accelerates what organisations can achieve.
  • Guide AI Adoption: Act as a credible, empathetic guide for customers who are excited about AI's potential but uncertain about where to start, building the safety needed to take bold steps forward.
  • Orchestrate Internal Partnerships: Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success to orchestrate seamless, high-value customer journeys.
  • Pioneer Sales Innovation: Experiment with new approaches and share what works, scaling regional innovations globally.

title: Customer Success Manager (AI Success Architect)
text:

As an AI Success Architect, you’ll help enterprise customers answer that question and turn Asana’s AI capabilities into measurable business results. You’ll own the post-sales relationship for a portfolio of ~50 enterprise accounts, acting as a strategic advisor with accountability for AI adoption, consumption, and commercial outcomes. In this advisory role, you’ll diagnose where AI changes how work gets done and guide the organizational change that makes it stick.

This role can either be fully remote depending on which US state you live in, or based in our Chicago office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. If based in-office: The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. What you’ll achieve

  • Serve as the trusted advisor and point of accountability for a portfolio of enterprise accounts across the customer lifecycle.

  • Assess how customers structure their work in Asana, guiding them to establish habits and governance that supply AI models with rich, consistent context.

  • Lead change management and enablement programs that build internal champions and ensure long-term, sustained adoption.

  • Track AI consumption and adoption against clear baselines and 30/60/90-day benchmarks, translating usage data into a compelling business story.

  • Identify expansion readiness for new AI use cases, products, or broader deployments, initiating conversations and partnering with the account team once validated.

  • Monitor account health, engagement, and sentiment to proactively mitigate risks well ahead of renewals.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, and Sales, while sharing structured customer insights with Product and Customer Success leadership.

About you

  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

text:

text:
Senior Data Scientist

[Data] • [Vancouver, BC]

 

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to help define Asana's growth strategy as users increasingly discover and adopt software through LLM interfaces like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. With millions of knowledge workers now starting their workday in conversational AI tools, we're at an inflection point in how productivity software reaches users. As part of the AI organization within Asana you'll leverage data to influence how we should build our agentic work management products. 

 

Asana's Data Science team helps us fulfill our mission by informing strategy, defining success metrics, and identifying new ways to deliver user value. Data scientists are at the crux of deepening our understanding of the customers and driving more business outcomes by leveraging experimentation, causal inference, statistical and machine learning techniques, and data storytelling.

 

This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday.   • Experience with AI/ML products, LLM APIs, or third-party platform integrations. Strong preference for candidates who've worked with conversational AI or built features integrating ChatGPT, Claude, or similar platforms.

title: Developer Advocate
text:
Developer Advocate

We’re looking for an experienced Developer Advocate in our Vancouver Office. Our work informs teams at every level of the company and drives key roadmap decisions. Asana’s developer platform is growing, and we need a credible external voice in the developer and AI community. This role is about presence, trust, and distribution. You will represent Asana in the spaces where developers and builders actually live: on social media, at conferences, in forums, and through the content you create, and you will represent those developers at Asana.

We’re looking for the kind of person other developers follow because they consistently reinforce a trusted feedback loop between developers and the companies they’re building with. We need someone who can speak with real authority on agents and agentic workflows — and can articulate, better than anyone outside the company, how Asana creates value in an agentic world. If people in your corner of the developer community already look to you for approaches to AI, agentic workflows, and/or productivity tooling, we want to talk.

This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

  • Design and execute developer engagement strategies that drive adoption of Asana’s platform, APIs, and SDKs.
  • Author high-quality technical content, including sample apps, code tutorials, technical blog posts, and API documentation.
  • Engage with the developer community across forums, events, workshops, and social channels, serving as the primary advocate for developer needs.
  • Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, and Design to provide actionable developer feedback and help shape platform roadmaps.
  • Build strong cross-functional relationships with Marketing, Business Development, and Solutions Engineering to support partner integrations and growth.
  • Mentor and guide junior advocates and community members, elevating advocacy best practices across the organization.

About you

  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.
  • Proven track record as a Developer Advocate, Developer Relations Engineer, or Senior Software Engineer with substantial experience building developer community programs.
  • Deep technical background with hands-on experience building and consuming RESTful APIs, webhooks, and modern SDKs in languages like JavaScript, Python, or Ruby.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a passion for breaking down complex technical topics into engaging, accessible content.

[Singapore]

title: Experience Researcher, PLG
text:
Our work informs teams at every level of Asana and drives key roadmap decisions. We partner with Product Design, Product Management, Data Science, and Engineering, as well as business and marketing teams, to develop valuable insights about customer behaviors and attitudes, translating them into actionable recommendations. We think deeply about new areas, help develop and test concepts, and improve products and services once they’ve rolled out. As a Senior Experience Researcher, you will be a strategic partner who not only executes high-impact research but also shapes the research culture to elevate our collective craft.

This role is based in our Vancouver office. Day to day collaboration is split roughly 50/50 between Vancouver teammates and San Francisco teammates. Locally, you will work closely with our PLG Adoption teams, specifically partnering with the AI Activations (AIA) and Conversion and Retention (CoRe) teams. Key local partners include Product Managers, Designers, and Engineering leads.

We operate with an office-centric hybrid schedule. In-office days are Monday, Tuesday and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you interview for this role, your recruiter will share more about in-office requirements.

In this role, you will help shape and scale Asana’s Product-Led Growth (PLG) self-serve business. We recently launched several major new products—including AI Teammates, a Meetings product, and Asana for Client Management (ACM). We are also preparing two more major product lines for launch, which will unlock entirely new workflows and use cases for our customers.  Historically, our growth relied on selling more seats or moving customers to higher tiers. Now, we have multiple new growth vectors, from AI credit consumption to these brand new product offerings. You will play a pivotal role in uncovering how to introduce users to these products, encourage users to try them, adopt them into their daily workflows, and deepen their usage over time.   

The Experience Researcher plays a key role in defining the product roadmap and influencing how our PLG adoption strategy evolves. 

What you’ll achieve

In your first 4-5 months, you will partner with Adoption teams on immediate Q4 roadmap priorities, building out the self-serve pathways to buy and adopt our newest products. Over time, your remit will expand as we roll out self-serve motions for additional products.

Be a strategic partner: Together with your cross-functional partners (Product, Design, Engineering, Data Science) you’ll uncover how to best introduce users to Asana’s new products, encourage users to try them out, drive adoption in daily workflows, and deepen usage over time.   Drive ACM self serve growth: Research how users discover Asana for Client Management (ACM), start using it, adopt advanced features, and expand its footprint across their organization.Uncover opportunities and pathways for how AI teammates, the Meetings product, and the client portal help customers extract more value from ACM and invite cross-functional collaboration.Lead research on new concepts: Lead research on new concepts: Drive exploratory and evaluative research for upcoming product additions, assessing whether new concepts and personalized experiences feel valuable enough to encourage user engagement and organic sharing.Build a foundation for future PLG offerings: Identify high-impact research needs to support the self-serve rollouts for the next two major product launches. Connect insights to business impact: Ensure research directly influences the roadmap to meet critical business metrics, supporting our goals for AI ARR growth, higher-LTV customers, and increased NRR.

About you

  • 6+ years of experience practicing UX Research for digital products, with a proven track record of leading large-scale projects. 
  • Strong proficiency in mixed-methods research, seamlessly combining qualitative deep-dives (contextual inquiry, prototype testing) with quantitative validation (survey design, behavioral data analysis) to triangulate insights and build high-confidence recommendations.
  • Mature product judgement with the ability to distill messy signal into clear, "low-polish" deliverables that drive immediate decision-making.
  • Strong organizational leadership and the ability to manage multiple complex workstreams while building deep trust and rapport with senior stakeholders.
  • Deep understanding of interaction design and content hierarchy, allowing you to partner effectively with Design and Content Strategy to reduce friction and drive user action.
  • Persuasive communicator who can influence product strategy through storytelling and evidence-based recommendations.
  • Actively experimenting with AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making. We’re looking for researchers who can harness AI to extend and deepen the ways in which we develop insights and leverage them across the org.

The Asana Marketing team is responsible for fueling business growth and building a brand customers love, partnering across the business to create a holistic digital strategy that ensures our website looks, performs, and drives measurable results in telling Asana’s story to the world. In this role, you will set the strategy for how key personas discover, understand, and navigate the site, while leading web strategy, localization, web platform (CMS), and the engineering capacity that brings it to life.

This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. What you’ll achieve

  • Own the website's contribution to web conversion and pipeline, establishing a robust measurement framework and analytics practice that makes performance visible across the business.

  • Build and prioritize the global web roadmap by synthesizing user research, analytics, experimentation, and cross-functional stakeholder input.

  • Establish operational rigor across planning, intake, prioritization, and release cycles, ensuring the website ships quickly while maintaining high quality and governance.

  • Drive an AI-first web operations model, integrating AI tools to accelerate content workflows, QA, localization, and data analysis.

  • Oversee the web platform (CMS) architecture and roadmap, optimizing site performance, reliability, Core Web Vitals, and operational costs.

  • Lead and support the web engineering and localization teams, setting technical delivery standards and ensuring international visitors receive an exceptional localized experience.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Demand Generation, SEO, Paid Media, Data Science, and Brand Design to align business priorities with customer needs.

About you

  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

  • Proven track record leading web or digital strategy for complex, multi-product B2B SaaS websites, with measurable impact on conversion rates and sales pipeline.

  • People leadership experience managing multi-disciplinary or technical teams, including web platform engineers, developers, and agency partners.

  • Strong fluency across modern web architecture, CMS platforms, site performance, Core Web Vitals, and technical delivery workflows.

  • Deep grounding in user journeys, persona-based messaging, and customer research, using experimentation and web analytics to guide priorities.

title: Lead Product Manager, Enterprise Services Management
text:
Lead Product Manager, Enterprise Services Management 

The Product Management team drives Asana’s product strategy and execution, translating customer needs and opportunities into a compelling roadmap and working cross-functionally to deliver impactful solutions for team productivity and collaboration. We’re helping to define the Work Management category and inventing new ways for teams to work more efficiently together and see the larger purpose behind their work. Our team works directly with Engineering, Design, Experience Research, and Data Science, as well as with Sales, Support, and Marketing to ship great products. You’ll take part in every type of product work here — from strategy to product to process improvements — conceptualizing, launching, and iterating on Asana itself for millions of teams around the world.

Asana is building its next major business line: Service Management, powered by AI agents and tightly integrated with Asana’s Work Graph. This is a 0→1 opportunity to define how IT, HR, and Support teams resolve work, automate workflows, and connect tickets to projects in a modern, AI-native platform. We’re looking for a hands-on, highly entrepreneurial Lead PM who combines deep product craft with customer obsession, technical fluency, and strong go-to-market instincts. This person will help incubate a new business from scratch, partner directly with customers, and drive the product and GTM strategy required to build the next scalable product at Asana. 

This role is ideal for someone who loves ambiguity, builds quickly, learns from customers, and has experience shaping AI agentic workflows, IT/service automation tools, or adjacent enterprise SaaS products.

This role is based in our San Francisco office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

 

What you’ll achieve

  • Drive the 0→1 strategy and product vision by helping define the 3-year product strategy for Asana’s ESM business, including differentiation through AI agents, automations, and deep workflow integrations, and establishing Asana’s “right to win.
  • Partner deeply with customers by spending significant time validating pain points, co-developing workflows, and translating insights into clear MVP scope, an iterative roadmap, and measurable outcomes.
  • Build and launch an AI-native MVP, prioritizing a focused set of capabilities that solve real customer problems and collaborating closely with engineering, design, and UXR to build reliable, technical AI systems.
  • Drive cross-functional GTM by partnering with Sales, Channel, PMM, and CS on positioning, pricing, packaging, early lighthouse accounts, and working with channel partners to refine migration and onboarding experiences.
  • Operate with startup-level hustle and high velocity, breaking down ambiguous problems, shipping iteratively, validating quickly, learning from real usage, and staying scrappy and passionate about the 0→1 stage.


About you

  • 10+ years of Product Management experience, with demonstrated success building AI-driven platforms, automation systems, service workflows, or enterprise SaaS products; experience with multi-agent systems, LLM-powered workflows, or AI operations is a plus.
  • Strong 0→1 builder — you’ve built and scaled new products or incubations before and operate with urgency, resourcefulness, and creativity, pushing through ambiguity.
  • Technical systems thinker, comfortable going deep on architecture, flows, and tradeoffs with engineering, and able to reason about integrations, identity systems, workflow engines, and AI agent behavior.
  • Customer-centric, thriving in customer conversations and translating qualitative insights into sharp product decisions; energized by solving real operational pain.
  • Commercially and GTM savvy, equally comfortable in customer pitches, channel partner discussions, and pricing conversations as you are writing PRDs; skilled at positioning and selling into both mid-market and enterprise.
  • Communication and collaboration: exceptional communicator with crisp writing, clear storytelling, and the ability to persuade across engineering, design, sales, and executive stakeholders while bringing clarity to ambiguity.
  • Growth mindset and AI-first thinker, curious, adaptable, and eager to leverage emerging technologies to elevate product experiences and internal workflows.

text:

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager to join the team that keeps complex, interdependent work accurate as it changes. This team owns tasks and how they connect and stay in sync — including subtasks, dependencies, milestones, and the approvals that keep changes safe — across the views people plan from like the Task Pane, Board, Timeline, Gantt, and Project Overview. These mechanics are what let enterprise teams model their most complex initiatives directly in Asana, so decisions here carry real revenue and competitive weight. With Asana's recent launch of Agentic Work Management, where AI Teammates work alongside people on the same plan, this PM will help pioneer this new category — owning the strategy for keeping scheduling and task relationships trustworthy as agents, not just people, propose and make changes.

 

This role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays and Fridays. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

 

What you'll achieve:

  • Set the strategy for how tasks connect and stay in sync as plans change — dependencies, durations, milestones, and the approval loops that keep updates safe — aligned with broader group goals
  • Drive end-to-end delivery of multi-month initiatives — from problem definition through launch — often defining work that lands on other teams' roadmaps and requires coordinating delivery across multiple teams, rather than owning a single piece of a larger initiative
  • Scope tight MVPs and prioritize rigorously, making sound decisions even without perfect information
  • Facilitate complex, multi-team alignment — our surfaces touch nearly every other team at Asana, so building consensus and driving cross-functional coordination is central to the role
  • Connect regularly with customers, using those insights to guide strategy, especially around how large and enterprise teams configure and scale their use of Asana
  • Mentor other product managers and help raise the bar on product craft across the team

 

About you:

  • 6-8 years of Product Management experience, with a track record of driving — not just contributing to — end-user features rather than purely internal or platform-only work
  • Experience shipping multi-month, end-to-end initiatives that require close coordination across multiple teams, including work that puts deliverables on other teams' roadmaps, where you owned the full arc from definition to delivery
  • You understand how complex, interdependent work actually gets planned and scheduled in large organizations — shifting timelines, messy dependency chains, and approval processes that vary team to team — and you've shaped product decisions around that complexity, not just built controls to manage it

title: Product Security Engineer
text:
At Asana, security is foundational to our mission of helping humanity thrive by enabling the world's teams to work together effortlessly. Our security team protects Asana's employees, users, and customers by proactively addressing threats and fostering a culture of security throughout our product and operations.

We're looking for a Product Security Engineer to join our Product Security team in Warsaw. You'll be a foundational member of the security presence in a key engineering hub, partnering directly with product and infrastructure teams to ensure we design and ship secure software. You will be instrumental in scaling our security practices by building secure-by-default frameworks, eliminating entire classes of vulnerabilities, and championing a security-first mindset across our web, mobile, and AI-powered product surfaces.

This role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do, and your recruiter can share more about the in-office requirements.

We offer a Contract of Employment (UoP) for our employees in Poland.

What you'll achieve

  • Partner with product and engineering teams across the full software development lifecycle to ensure security is designed and built into Asana's products and platform.
  • Conduct security architecture reviews, threat modeling, and code reviews for new features and services.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain secure-by-default frameworks and libraries that empower engineering teams to build secure systems easily.
  • Build and maintain automated security tooling (static and dynamic analysis rules, custom SAST/DAST checks, and automated red-teaming) to scale security coverage without scaling headcount.
  • Identify and address AI-specific security risks such as prompt injection, insecure tool permissions, and abuse-resistant design in Asana's AI and agentic features.
  • Triage, investigate, and drive remediation of vulnerabilities from our bug bounty program, internal testing, and automated security tooling.
  • Influence engineering initiatives by conducting design and roadmap reviews, effectively communicating security constraints, and assisting teams in making informed trade-offs.
  • Investigate product security incidents as a subject matter expert, using logs and monitoring tools to contain, analyze, and drive resolution.
  • Evaluate and improve software supply chain security, including dependency management, SCA tooling, and third-party risk in the development pipeline.
  • Develop and deliver training to educate engineers on secure coding best practices and emerging threats.
  • Stay informed of industry trends, emerging threats, and best practices to ensure that Asana's security posture remains robust.
  • Collaborate with teammates and stakeholders to develop both short-term and long-term strategies for risk management.

About you

  • 5+ years of experience in application security, product security, or software engineering with a security focus.
  • Strong software engineering background with experience in languages like Python, Javascript/Typescript or Scala.
  • Deep working knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 and common web application vulnerabilities such as XSS, CSRF, SSRF, and SQL injection.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML security concepts, including LLM-specific risks such as prompt injection and agentic attack surfaces.
  • Experience with security tools for static/dynamic analysis (SAST/DAST), software composition analysis (SCA), and vulnerability management.
  • Experience performing security design reviews and threat modeling for complex applications.
  • Excellent communication skills for collaborating effectively with both technical and non-technical partners.
  • A pragmatic and collaborative mindset, with a passion for building defenses against real-world attacks and enabling other engineers to do their best, most secure work.
  • Demonstrated curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

  • Mental Health Support in Modern Health
  • Group life insurance
  • MacBooks with all necessary accessories

title: Renewal Manager
text:

As a Renewals team member, your main responsibility is to oversee client renewals, renew existing licenses, discover growth opportunities, identify/mitigate risk and ensure high customer satisfaction to minimize churn. This role involves understanding customer needs, building strong relationships, having strong negotiation skills and staying current on Asana’s pricing and packaging.

This role can either be fully remote depending on which US state you live in, or based in our Chicago office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. If based in-office: The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. text:

As an Analytical Engineering Manager, you lead a team of Analytical Engineers who own the data foundations for the business: the Gold layer, canonical metrics, certified dashboards, and semantic layer that make Asana's most important numbers trustworthy, and that make AI-powered self-serve through Claude and Databricks Genie actually work. title: Senior Analytics Engineer
text:
Senior Analytics Engineer

The Data Science & Analytics team at Asana is how the company turns data into decisions — defining the questions that matter, surfacing the answers, and making sure insight is at the center of every critical product and business call. As a Senior Analytical Engineer, you sit at the intersection of Data Engineering, Analytics, and Data Science, and you own the data foundations for a business domain end to end. Your mandate is to turn raw data into reliable, business-ready datasets that PMs, analysts, data scientists, and leaders actually trust and use — and to define the business logic and metric standards that make AI-powered self-serve trustworthy. You consume governed Silver tables and produce the Gold layer and semantic layer beneath Asana's most important metrics, dashboards, and Genie spaces. 

This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do, and your recruiter can share more about the in-office requirements. 

What you’ll achieve

  • Own the Gold layer for a given business domain (e.g., PLG funnel, marketing attribution, revenue, NPI/AWM): Design and continuously improve the curated, dimensional data models that downstream dashboards, Genie spaces, and ELT reporting depend on.

  • Implement the canonical business logic behind your domain's core KPIs: Translate KPIs into governed, versioned metric marts that resolve "this number doesn't match" disputes for good.

  • Build and curate the semantic layer and Genie spaces that power self-serve in your domain: Author the metadata, documentation, and prompt/metric definitions that let stakeholders query governed data in plain language through Claude and Databricks Genie.

  • Own the metric dictionary for your domain: a single source of truth for what each metric means, who owns it, and where to find it. Partner with peers across DS&A to keep KPI definitions consistent where domains overlap.

  • Author data contracts and SLAs at the Silver→Gold boundary, partnering with Horizontal Data Engineering on the inputs you depend on, and owning data quality, freshness, and oncall for Gold/metric-mart failures in your domain.

  • Build and maintain certified, board-ready dashboards on governed Gold data, partnering with Data Science to translate insight requirements into trusted, reusable products rather than one-off builds.

  • Partner directly with Product & Business, Data Science, and Engineering to turn ambiguous, underspecified questions into scalable datasets — anticipating downstream reporting impacts before they become incidents, and raising the data-model quality bar across the domains you touch.

About you

  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

  • 4+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a closely related analytics role, with a track record of independently owning the data models a team relies on for decisions.

  • Advanced SQL and strong data modeling fundamentals: dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, slowly changing dimensions, and semantic layer design.

  • Hands-on experience with a transformation framework (dbt or equivalent), orchestration tooling (e.g. Airflow), version control (Git), and modern warehouse/lakehouse platforms (Databricks experience preferred).

  • Practical experience with data quality testing and observability, schema management and data contracts, and query/model performance and cost tuning.

  • Demonstrated domain fluency in at least one business area (e.g. PLG funnels, SLG pipeline, marketing attribution, Product telemetry, revenue/ARR) and the judgment to translate "I don't trust this number" into a specific, durable model fix.

  • Strong cross-functional partnership skills: requirement gathering, prioritization, documentation and enablement, driving alignment on metric definitions, and explaining technical tradeoffs to non-technical partners.

  • Curiosity about AI-native analytics — NL2SQL, metadata/semantic layers for self-serve, and using tools like Claude and Genie to multiply your reach rather than replace rigor. Exposure to Unity Catalog, Looker/LookML, or reverse-ETL/activation (Salesforce, Marketo, Gainsight) is a plus

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer (Software-Focused)
text:
We're looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer who brings strong software engineering skills and a deep understanding of production systems. This role is a good fit for someone who enjoys building systems that make infrastructure more scalable, reliable, and easy to operate – using code, not runbooks.

You'll work with a highly collaborative team to design and build the internal platforms that power all of Asana, from product features to AI systems to offline analytics. Our tech stack includes: AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), MySQL (RDS), OpenSearch, DynamoDB, Redis, Terraform, Datadog, TypeScript, Scala, Go, and Python.

We’re especially interested in people who think like backend engineers but care deeply about systems – things like failure modes, operational cost, debuggability, and performance.

This role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do, and your recruiter can share more about the in-office requirements.

We offer a Contract of Employment (UoP) for our employees in Poland.

What you’ll achieve:

  • Design and build frameworks, tools, and services that improve the reliability, observability, and scalability of Asana’s infrastructure.
  • Lead end-to-end projects, from scoping and design through to rollout, across multiple systems and teams.
  • Improve the operability of stateful infrastructure like MySQL, OpenSearch, and DynamoDB – and help drive Asana’s long-term vision for storage reliability.
  • Debug production issues across the stack. Yes, there’s an on-call rotation – but this isn’t a pager monkey role. You’re here to fix things properly and make sure they don’t break again.
  • Partner with product teams to shape a service-oriented architecture that enables fast, reliable development.
  • Share knowledge through code reviews, design discussions, and mentorship.

About you:

  • Strong software engineering background – you’re comfortable writing production code and designing systems (we use Go, Python, Scala, TypeScript).
  • 5+ years of experience building and operating backend systems at scale.
  • Familiarity with distributed systems and storage technologies (SQL, NoSQL, Search), especially in cloud environments.
  • Experience with AWS services (e.g. RDS, EKS, IAM), Terraform, and monitoring tooling like Datadog or similar.
  • Solid understanding of SRE principles (e.g. SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, incident response), but you approach reliability as a software problem first.
  • Clear communicator and strong collaborator – you're comfortable navigating trade-offs with stakeholders across the stack.
  • Important: If you’re only comfortable with scripting, this isn’t the right role. We’re looking for engineers who build and ship real systems.
  • Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making

Why this role?

  • Founding team: You’ll be one of the first SREs in Warsaw – and a key player in a growing team.
  • Drive real change: This isn’t a role where you’ll just patch up legacy systems. We are expecting (and supporting) real architectural changes to improve reliability, scalability, and long-term operability.
  • Big impact: Our product is scaling fast, and reliability is a top company priority.
  • Room to grow: As this team grows, so will your influence – whether you want to lead projects, mentor others, or help shape how we scale.
  • Global collaboration: Work closely with experienced engineers in San Francisco, Reykjavik, and Warsaw, while helping build the future of SRE at Asana.

  • Home office setup budget.
  • Gym/Fitness reimbursement.
  • Fertility healthcare and family-forming support with Carrot.
  • Mental health support in Modern Health.
  • Group life insurance.
  • MacBooks with all necessary accessories.

title: Senior Product Manager, AI Context
text:
Asana is building the platform for human and agent collaboration in the enterprise. With the launch of Agentic Work Management (AWM), AI is now a foundational part of that platform, and the shift brings a new class of problems with it. Customers need to trust agentic work, govern it, and see a return on it before they will scale it. Many of the opportunities that matter most for customers sit between our suite of AI products, rather than inside any particular one—which is where you come in. 

This role sits in our AI Platform Group on a small, fast-moving team with a deliberately broad mandate: work across the boundaries other product teams operate within, identify the cross-cutting problems and opportunities that no single team owns, and build leveraged solutions that create scalable, differentiated value for our customers.

This role is based in our New York City office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday.   • Discover and quickly validate new, high-leverage opportunities, then work cross functionally to deliver end-to-end solutions, fast.
  • Consistently choose leverage over local wins: pick the problems whose solutions compound across Asana's AI products rather than improving a single surface in isolation.
  • Help set the standard for what Asana invests in versus not as the AI capability landscape shifts, piloting new capabilities and accelerating their adoption and integration into our AI products.
  • Decide which of our existing convictions are worth pursuing (if at all), and in what order: AI ROI measurement and reporting, AI governance, monitoring, and administration, building new capabilities for managing complex, cross-functional agentic workflows.

About you
